meaning:
1) to patch, spot, be spotted, be coloured
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to spot
1a2) spotted (participle)
1b) (Pual) to be patched

elsewhere.note: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled…
and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.
You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shall not happen…
